description: The base modal (a PrimeVue Dialog) opens via the command palette, traps focus, and closes via its X button, Escape and a backdrop click. To "open the feature flags modal": press Control+k (the command palette shortcut), wait for the command palette input (".command-palette-input") to be visible, fill it with "feature", wait for the first ".command-palette-item" to be visible and click it. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Open the feature flags modal. 3. The mask (".modal-overlay") and the panel (".modal") should be visible, and ".modal-title" should have exactly the text "Feature flags". 4. The element with role="dialog" should have aria-modal="true" and a non-empty aria-labelledby; the element whose id is that aria-labelledby value must have exactly the text "Feature flags" and the class "modal-title" (PrimeVue's default, never-rendered header id would fail this). 5. Focus moves into the dialog: poll an eval of document.querySelector('.modal')?.contains(document.activeElement) until it is true. 6. The close button ".modal-header .btn-icon[aria-label='Close modal']" should be visible. 7. Click it: then no ".modal" element may exist at all (count 0). 8. Open the feature flags modal again and wait for ".modal" to be visible; press Escape: ".modal" count should become 0. 9. Open the feature flags modal again and wait for ".modal" to be visible; click the mask ".modal-overlay" 5 pixels right and 5 pixels down from its top-left corner (well outside the centered panel): ".modal" count should become 0.

steps.expression: (function(){ const dlg = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); const id = dlg ? dlg.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') : ''; return id && id.length > 0 ? 'has-id' : 'no-id'; })()
